🌟 Pythia | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide agents and users with a comprehensive, real-time, and predictive understanding of global events and their potential future trajectories, all processed locally without ongoing costs.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time global intelligence feeds (news, conflict, weather, cyber, markets, etc.) • 24-hour, weekly, monthly, and yearly forecasts • Runs entirely on local hardware (no cloud dependencies)
📖 Summary: Pythia is a local, cost-free API that provides real-time global intelligence and future forecasts by fusing live world feeds with a swarm-intelligence prediction engine. It runs entirely on user hardware, offering a unified, machine-readable view of global events and their potential outcomes for agents and decision-making.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 trail-mate | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling reliable communication, navigation, and team situational awareness in off-grid or no-network environments, prioritizing user control and data sovereignty.
✨ Key Features: • Offline-first operation • Decentralized communication (Meshtastic, MeshCore, Reticulum) • Anonymous operation • On-device TAK capability for situational awareness • User-controlled identity and data storage
📖 Summary: Trail Mate is a decentralized, offline-first system for secure communication and situational awareness in environments without network access. It prioritizes user control over identity, data, and connectivity, running on personal devices for navigation, team coordination, and data management.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 guardian-cli | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and enhancing penetration testing workflows with AI intelligence and a comprehensive suite of security tools.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-Provider AI Intelligence (7+ providers including local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) • Plugin Provider Contract for easy third-party integration • Multi-Agent Architecture with specialized roles and debate triage • Vision-LLM Visual Triage for image-grounded analysis
📖 Summary: Guardian is an AI-powered penetration testing automation framework that integrates multiple AI providers and a wide array of security tools. It aims to deliver intelligent, adaptive security assessments with features like multi-agent debate triage and RAG-based knowledge bases to reduce false positives and improve efficiency.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Raven | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a secure, on-device AI assistant for querying and summarizing personal documents on macOS and iOS.
✨ Key Features: • Text extraction from images, PDFs, audio, and video files • Audio transcription and video text extraction • Smart Q&A and contextual content analysis • Local AI processing using Apple Foundation Models • Project creation and file organization
📖 Summary: Raven is a privacy-focused AI assistant app for macOS and iOS that allows users to upload documents and ask questions. It leverages Apple's on-device Foundation Models for all processing, ensuring data remains local and no internet connection is required for its core AI features.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 likec4 | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate and maintain up-to-date software architecture diagrams directly from source code, enabling better visualization and collaboration on architectural designs.
✨ Key Features: • Architecture as code • Generates diagrams from code • Inspired by C4 Model and Structurizr DSL • Customizable notation, element types, and nesting levels • Live preview with CLI
📖 Summary: LikeC4 is a tool that generates software architecture diagrams directly from code, inspired by the C4 model. It allows for visualization, collaboration, and evolution of architecture by treating it as code, offering flexibility in defining custom notations and element types.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
